records.question: Pablo likes to put together jigsaw puzzles. He can put together an average of 100 pieces per hour. He has eight puzzles with 300 pieces each and five puzzles with 500 pieces each. If Pablo only works on puzzles for a maximum of 7 hours each day, how many days will it take him to complete all of his puzzles?
records.response:
The first eight puzzles have 8*300 = 2400 pieces.
The second five puzzles have 5*500 = 2500 pieces.
Thus, Pablo has 2400 + 2500 = 4900 pieces to put together.
Pablo can put together 100*7 = 700 pieces per day.
Therefore, it will take him 4900 / 700 = 7 days to complete all of his puzzles.
#### 7

records.question: A shop sold 29 bags of potatoes in the morning. In the afternoon, the shop sold 17 bags of potatoes. If each bag of potatoes weighs 7kg, how many kilograms of potatoes did the shop sell for the whole day?
records.response:
The shop sold 29+17=46 bags of potatoes.
Thus, the shop sold 46*7=322 kilograms of potatoes.
#### 322
